context: A rainy afternoon. Hina and Sho are stuck inside; Hina has invented a game with cushions.
purpose: two children indoors — older-pretender leading younger one through invented play

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: It's raining. We can't go outside.
lines.style: High child wilted observation, the bright-edge of disappointment, soft real childish frustration threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old single-word lament, the soft small honest disclosure, soft small fatigue threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: じゃあ！クッションでお城作ろう！
lines.en: Then! Let's build a castle with cushions!
lines.style: High child sudden bright invention burst, the energy-spike full of childish creativity, soft real joy throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お城？ぼく、入っていいの？
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old curious soft asking, the gentle wanting-to-join audible, soft small interest threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: もちろん！しょうくんが王子様ね。ルール教えるよ！
lines.en: Of course! Sho-kun is the prince. I'll teach you the rules!
lines.style: High child warm bright inclusion, the confident leader-pretending audible, soft real childish love threading throughout delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Tiny six-year-old soft warming acceptance, the gentle interest growing audible, soft small enthusiasm threading throughout delivery.
